title: my dark gothic 2D game
author: gebirgshang-eth
selftext:
This is still an early prototype, so the visuals, animations, UI, combat balance and level layouts are all being developed and refined.

Some assets and effects are still placeholders while I test the mechanics and overall experience.

I've been building this for a while. Sunken world, a broken bell, a character named Llyra working through what the bell used to keep quiet. There are two hubs, six distinct areas together they make 45 branching off it, a boss closing each one, and a progression system tying it together.

Made with Claude code & Higgsfield

Honest criticism is welcome.

comments.author: proximalcoast
comments.body:
Deaf sex ton, huh? 

The run and the combat speed do not match, it kills the momentum (Dead Cells has this perfect).

Stylistically, would like some what more consistency. It’s gory, but then dark. Maybe this is just the cut of the video?

All in all, looks fun
